finding.claim: Header-based auth trusts any client-supplied username, usergroup and provider header; a client sending provider=system satisfies IsSystemExecution and bypasses the justification requirement (config-dependent: requires authHttpHeaderUsername to be set and the listener reachable without a header-stripping proxy).
finding.source: HTTP request headers: the configured username header, usergroup header, and 'provider'

trace.note: checkUserFromHeaders reads username header with no trusted-proxy check
provider taken verbatim from client header
header checker is first in authChain
first user with non-empty Username wins

finding.guards_checked: Username must be non-empty; IsSystemExecution excludes only username 'guest'. No check that provider is server-assigned, no trusted-proxy or source-IP check, no header stripping.

finding.claim: StartActionByGet and StartActionByGetAndWait never call validateJustificationRequired, so actions configured with a mandatory justification run with an empty justification for any caller holding exec permission.
finding.source: Any authenticated or guest caller with exec ACL on an action whose config sets justification (no special privilege)
finding.sink: Action execution with empty justification recorded in the log (executor.go:1019)

trace.note: ResolveJustification returns empty for non-system users; no rejection
RestartAction does enforce justification, so enforcement is inconsistent

finding.guards_checked: Exec ACL in executor chain (executor.go:189-201, 832-845) is enforced. No justification check on this path.

finding.claim: UNVERIFIED: if connect-go serves StartActionByGet over HTTP GET, cookie-authenticated cross-site top-level navigation could trigger the victim's permitted actions (SameSite=Lax cookies are sent on top-level GET). The NO_SIDE_EFFECTS annotation that gates GET was not present in the repository snapshot.
finding.source: Cross-site page navigating the victim's browser to a connect GET URL carrying olivetin-sid-local

trace.note: StartActionByGet reachable via GET only if idempotency annotation permits (not verified)

finding.guards_checked: SameSite=Lax and HttpOnly on cookie; no CSRF token; GET-enablement could not be confirmed from source.

finding.claim: Webhook actions run with no authentication when authType is unset (config-dependent), and justification is never enforced on the webhook path, so an unauthenticated POST can trigger justification-required actions with an empty or attacker-chosen justification.
finding.source: Any unauthenticated POST matching attacker-controllable header, query or JSON-path matchers

trace.note: AuthType empty or none returns true unconditionally
matchers use attacker-controlled headers/query/path, not authentication
justification taken from payload, never validated against action requirement

finding.guards_checked: POST-only; 1 MiB body cap (handler.go:57-59); declared-argument filter; HMAC/bearer/basic compare constant-time when configured (auth.go:87-91,135,165); GitHub templates default to HMAC fail-closed (github.go:29-36). No justification enforcement.

finding.claim: PasswordHash RPC is unauthenticated and performs Argon2id (64 MiB, 4 passes) per request, usable as a resource-exhaustion amplifier.
finding.guards_checked: Concurrency semaphore only; no authentication, no per-client rate limit.

finding.claim: Local login has no per-account throttling or lockout, and unknown usernames return before any hashing, creating a username-enumeration timing oracle.
finding.source: Unauthenticated LocalUserLogin requests with chosen username and password

trace.note: user nil returns false before any Argon2 work
no rate limit or lockout in LocalUserLogin

finding.guards_checked: Argon2id hashing; global concurrency cap of 10. No per-user or per-IP limiting, no lockout.

finding.claim: Argument regexes for ascii_identifier, unicode_identifier, shell_safe_identifier and ascii_sentence allow a leading '-', so option-like values reach exec argv (no '--' separator) or sh -c, enabling option injection into the invoked program.
finding.source: Client-supplied argument value for an identifier-typed argument
finding.sink: exec argv (parseExecArray, arguments.go:30-41) or Shell template substitution

trace.note: regex match only; no leading-dash rejection
values passed as argv with no '--' separator

finding.guards_checked: Type regex allowlist; free-form types blocked for Shell (arguments.go:371-403); shell metacharacters excluded by charset. Option-prefix not rejected. Impact depends on the invoked program.

finding.claim: OAuth callback writes to h.registeredStates[state] while holding h.mu without defer unlock; if the entry was deleted during the token exchange, a nil-pointer panic leaves the mutex locked and blocks later OAuth lock acquisitions (race; plausible, not reproduced).
finding.source: Two concurrent callbacks with the same state and two distinct valid authorization codes, plus a logout revoking the state

trace.note: state looked up and found before exchange
token exchange (network I/O) creates race window
nil dereference if entry deleted by RevokeSession (426-430)

finding.guards_checked: Cookie-equals-query state check and registry lookup before exchange; net/http recovers the panic per request so the process survives.

finding.claim: DumpVars has no authentication check and, when InsecureAllowDumpVars is enabled, returns template context including environment variables that may contain secrets.
finding.source: Any network client, when the insecure flag is set by the operator
finding.sink: JSON dump of tpl.GetNewGeneralTemplateContext including Env (templates.go:147-148)
finding.guards_checked: Config flag InsecureAllowDumpVars (documented as insecure); no auth.

finding.claim: JWT validation accepts tokens without an exp claim and checks audience only when configured, so tokens can remain valid indefinitely and be accepted across audiences (config-dependent hardening).
finding.source: Bearer or cookie JWT issued by the configured IdP

trace.note: aud parser option added only if AuthJwtAud set
jwt.Parse with default options; exp not required
username and groups taken from claims without further checks

finding.guards_checked: Algorithm family pinned (jwt.go:159-163, 174-176); signature verified by configured key or JWKS.
